# Double Dynamic Dragon puzzles - AIC limit 1, max 3 techniques per step (reference list; nothing in the app loads this file)
#
# Verified 2026-09-30 with the corrected "Limit to 1 AIC per step" (a step may rely on at most one AIC; dead-end AICs don't count).
# Settings: every Dynamic Dragon technique enabled, "Limit to 1 AIC per step" ON, "Max techniques per step" = 3,
# plus every standalone technique (all AIC kinds, all fish, ALS-xz, Double Dragon Colouring), Exhaustive Dragon Colouring ON.
#
# Each puzzle was verified through the app's own engine (buildTechniqueInstances) with those settings:
#  - at the "stuck" position(s) nothing progresses - not single Dynamic Dragon, not Double (plain) Dragon, nothing else -
#    until Double Dynamic Dragon Colouring is turned on, and then only Double Dynamic rows appear;
#  - with it on, the whole puzzle is solved with no guessing, every step checked against the real solution.
#
# "puzzle" = the clues (81 chars, 0 = empty). "stuck at" = the first stuck position as a Sudoku.Coach state
# (board, givens and candidates) - import it into the app, or import the puzzle string and solve up to it.
# Most are famous hardest puzzles (Easter Monster, Kolk, Inkala 2012, AI Escargot, ...) or those plus one correct
# extra clue; some come straight from the magictour top1465 collection.
#
# Count: 9
